evidence: Clicking a restaurant card (The Golden Fork) navigates to /restaurant/1 detail page showing cuisine type "French", price "$$$$", address, description, amenities, and reviews section.
Typing "Sakura" into the search box filtered the list from "6 restaurants available" to "1 restaurant available", showing only Sakura Garden.

Search is live-filtering with no dedicated submit button; clearing the search box returns to the default unfiltered "6 restaurants available" browse view rather than performing/triggering an empty search action.

Date picker disables all past dates: in the current month (Sept 2026), days 30/31/1/2 (before today, Sept 2, 2026) are disabled; navigating to the previous month (August 2026) shows every single day disabled, preventing selection of any past date.

Selected date (Sep 10, 2026), time (18:00), party size (4 Guests), filled name/email/phone, clicked Confirm Reservation. Received toast "Reservation Confirmed! Your table at The Golden Fork is booked for September 10, 2026 at 18:00." and a confirmation panel with "View My Reservations" / "Make Another Reservation" options.

Entered coupon code "WELCOME10" and clicked Apply; toast showed "Coupon Applied! 10% off your first reservation" and the coupon field updated to display "WELCOME10 - 10% off" with a remove button. Reservation then submitted successfully with the coupon applied.

/reservations page shows "Upcoming (1)" tab with the created booking (The Golden Fork, Sep 10 2026, 18:00, 4 Guests, Downtown, coupon applied) and "Modify"/"Cancel" buttons available for the booking. Also a "Past (0)" tab exists.

Modified booking's time from 18:00 to 19:00 and party size from 4 to 6 Guests via the Modify dialog. After Save Changes, toast "Reservation Updated - Your reservation has been modified successfully." appeared and the reservation card correctly reflects the new values (19:00, 6 Guests) while other fields (date, restaurant, coupon) remained accurate.

Clicking "Modify" opened a dialog to re-select Time/Party Size and save; clicking "Cancel" opened an alertdialog "Cancel Reservation?" with "Keep Reservation"/"Cancel Reservation" buttons. Confirming showed toast "Reservation Cancelled" and moved the booking from Upcoming(0) to Past(1).

Submitted a 5-star review with name, visit date, and text on Sakura Garden's "Write a Review" tab. Toast "Review Submitted! Thank you for sharing your experience." appeared, and the Reviews tab count increased to (2), correctly showing the new review (Timothee Issenmann, Visited Aug 15 2026, 5 stars, review text) linked to Sakura Garden alongside the pre-existing review.

issue: Duplicate review submission is not prevented
actual: Submitted a second review for Sakura Garden using the exact same reviewer name ("Timothee Issenmann") and same visit date (2026-08-15) as an already-submitted review. The system accepted it without any warning or blocking, increasing the review count from (2) to (3) and adding a duplicate/near-duplicate entry. No mechanism ties reviews to a specific completed order/reservation to prevent repeat commenting on the same order.

evidence: 1) Applying GROUP15 with a 2-guest party was rejected: "Coupon Not Applicable - This coupon requires a party of 6 or more." 2) Once WELCOME10 was applied, the input field was replaced by an applied-coupon badge with only a remove option — no way to enter/apply a second coupon simultaneously, enforcing single-coupon-per-order (no combining). 3) An invalid code "INVALIDCODE99" was rejected: "Invalid Coupon - The coupon code you entered is not valid."

Restaurant detail pages (price "$$$$"/"$$", cuisine, address, description, amenities) show no edit controls anywhere in the user-facing UI — information is read-only. The Party Size selector on every restaurant reservation form is a fixed dropdown capped at "10 Guests" with no free-text entry, preventing users from booking beyond the maximum table capacity.

issue: No real-time discounted price calculation is displayed
actual: The reservation form lets users pick date/time/party size and apply a coupon (which shows a toast and a "-X% off" badge), and submission is correctly validated (missing required Name/Email/Phone blocks submission and focuses the first invalid field; confirmation/booking result is shown for valid submissions). However, nowhere in the flow is an actual price total or discounted price amount computed/displayed in real time — there is no subtotal, discount amount, or final total shown before or after applying a coupon, only the restaurant's general "$"-tier symbol and the coupon's percentage label.

issue: No message center to view historical notifications
actual: Booking status changes (create/modify/cancel reservation, apply coupon, submit review) do trigger real-time pop-up toast notifications (e.g., "Reservation Confirmed!", "Reservation Updated", "Reservation Cancelled"). However, the site's header navigation only offers "Restaurants" and "My Reservations" links — there is no notification bell, message center, or any page to view a history of past notifications. Once a toast disappears, there is no way to retrieve it.

issue: No personal center with comment history
actual: The only account-related page in the app is "/reservations" ("My Reservations"), which shows Upcoming/Past reservation cards (including cancelled ones) — this covers order/booking info but there is no personal-center section showing the user's own comment/review history (reviews the user submitted are only visible mixed into each restaurant's public Reviews tab, not aggregated anywhere for the user) and no "applications" section. The site header offers only "Restaurants" and "My Reservations" links, with no profile/account/personal-center page.
